title: Notification for when limited connection becomes normal
line: You can now turn on a notification that tells you when Internet access comes back after a period of limited connectivity.
explanation: plasma-nm's connectivity monitor shows a "Limited Connectivity" notification after connectivity has stayed limited for 10 seconds, but when NetworkManager later reports full connectivity it only closes that notification, so the only sign that the Internet is back is the tray icon losing its warning badge. The monitor now remembers that the limited notification was due and, when connectivity goes straight from limited to full, sends a new "Internet Access Restored" event. The event ships with Action=None, like Connection Added/Removed, so it is off by default and users turn on a popup and/or sound for it in System Settings > Notifications > Network Management.

commits.message:
kded: add optional notification when Internet access is restored

When connectivity stayed limited long enough to show a notification, there
was nothing telling the user once the connection worked again. Send a new
event in that case, disabled by default, that can be enabled in settings.

BUG: 507593

media.caption: Master: connectivity limited for 14 s shows "Limited Connectivity", then it becomes full and nothing tells the user
With the fix and the new event turned on: after the limited period, "Internet Access Restored" appears when connectivity becomes full
Master, a few seconds after connectivity became full: no notification
With the fix (event enabled): the "Internet Access Restored" notification

reviews.text: Adding an opt-in ConnectivityRestored KNotification event (Action=None in networkmanagement.notifyrc) gated on the existing 10-second limited-connectivity timer directly matches the maintainer's guidance in comments 3–5. It avoids firing on normal connect cycles or disconnects, still works when the user disables the Limited Connectivity popup to get sound-only restore alerts, and is cleanly implemented and verified.

Small, well-placed change in plasma-nm's kded ConnectivityMonitor: a flag set when the 10 s Limited Connectivity notification fires, and a new opt-in ConnectivityRestored event (Action=None) sent only on a direct limited-to-full transition. That is exactly what David Redondo asked for in comments 3-4: optional, and silent on the normal connect cycle that passes briefly through limited. It also covers the reporter's cases (modem syncing, long maintenance), and since it is a KNotification event they can pick a sound only, as asked in comment 2. The dbus-monitor regression checks (short blip, limited-none-full) and the before/after media back it up; commit message and explanation match the diff.
